The following are the statistics of the '''[[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]]''' in season 1993–1994.

==Overview==
Sixteen teams took part and [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray S.K.]] won the [[championship]]. The teams Karabükspor, Karsiyaka and Sariyer got relegated.
